purpose: Assess REA suitability for Great100 Studio competitors
artifact_boundary: Three publicly distributed JavaScript files only; this is not the complete Vrew application or desktop package.
acquisition_limitations: The declared index source map URL returned HTTP 200 text/html, not a source map; its body was not analyzed as a source map.
The Mootion storyteller root HTML was visible through web lookup, but local urllib and curl both failed with a TLS unexpected-message error; no Mootion editor bundle was acquired.
Fliki anonymous root HTML was acquired, but no authenticated editor bundle analysis was performed.
No target JavaScript was executed; no logged-in editing or generation requests were performed.
Desktop package architecture and native engines were not tested.
